parsed.change_summary: Added a bitwise AND operation with 0xFF to ensure the result of the left shift does not overflow.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding no longer works because the bitwise AND operation with 0xFF ensures that the result of the left shift operation does not exceed the bounds of an 8-bit value. This prevents integer overflow by masking the higher bits that would be set if the shift operation caused an overflow.
